pr_body:
Test stability status: https://k8s-testgrid.appspot.com/sig-release-master-blocking#gce-cos-master-default&width=5&sort-by-flakiness=&include-filter-by-regex=.*CustomResource.*

**What type of PR is this?**

/kind cleanup

**What this PR does / why we need it**:

CRDs graduate to GA in 1.16. Conformance tests are now required for graduation to GA.

**Which issue(s) this PR fixes**:

Fixes #81192

**Special notes for your reviewer**:

**Does this PR introduce a user-facing change?**:


pr_comments:
/test pull-kubernetes-conformance-image-test

`pull-kubernetes-conformance-kind-ipv6` failure is expected as https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/pull/81857#issuecomment-524489491 suggested

Hello! I'm the bug triage lead for the 1.16 release cycle and I'd just like to remind that the code freeze starts tomorrow PST EOD. Is there any ETA how much time will be needed to finish this PR?

As the underlying issue is in the v1.16 milestone (#81192), I'll add this PR to the milestone for tracing purposes.
/milestone v1.16

The ipv6 test is green (thanks @aojea!). We split out the test functionality change into a separate PR https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/pull/82061, so we can keep the conformance promotion clean. 

@johnbelamaric If things look good, I can squash and rebase on top of https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/pull/82061.
@johnbelamaric Rebased. The first commit is #82061 (in the merge queue), the second commit the conformance promotion.
added a [Privileged:ClusterAdmin] tag per discussion in https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/pull/81857#issuecomment-526281659

/lgtm

Note for conformance approvers: These tests require clusterAdmin, because this functionality is inherently privileged. To mitigate this in environments where the tests cannot be run as clusterAdmin, we added a `[Privileged:ClusterAdmin]` tag to that they can be easily excluded. This is a new tag and I will propose an update to the docs to cover this case.

Thanks @johnbelamaric! 

Note for conformance approvers: 
- The first commit is https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/pull/82061, which is in the merge queue already. This PR (the second commit) rebases on top of that. 
- ~There is a new test in the merge queue, which covers the last bit of endpoints (discovery doc) https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/pull/82036. I will add that test into conformance suite, either with an update in this pull or opening a separate pull, depending on how fast the merge queue goes~ I will keep this PR focusing on promoting the existing e2es. When we have new tests in tree I will create follow up PR for the new one
